evidence.V1: Silhouette reads as a round-canopy tree from front, three-quarter and top (lobed blob on a thin trunk); generic lollipop but recognisable at 64 px.
evidence.V2: Big canopy and medium trunk are clear, but the two branches are barely visible stubs hidden under the canopy (a dark notch in the fork close-up) and there is no small-scale detail (no root flare, bark, leaf clusters).
evidence.V3: Trunk is a straight, untapered column and the canopy a single puffy blob; only partly stylised, reads stiff rather than a confident chunky oak.
evidence.V4: Canopy lobes are soft, but the trunk base ends in a hard flat slab flare with a sharp band (trunk_base close-up) and the trunk sides are plain; edge treatment inconsistent.
evidence.V5: Canopy close-up in studio light shows a visible quad grid / faceting across the lobes and creased pinch lines where lobes merge; trunk is clean. Minor but visible.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one foliage green plus bark brown, good value contrast; colourways (autumn, frost) swap only the canopy hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 1876 tris vs tree target 2000 (ceiling 5000): at target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material and kit palette, but canopy grid faceting and single flat green value fall short of the smooth weighted-normal kit finish; minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Hull collision (trunk-only part option), CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre: correct.
